# R&G Remodeling and Roofing

> Owens Corning Preferred roofing contractor and remodeler serving Pittsburgh's South Hills since 1999. Roof replacement and repair in season, kitchen and bathroom remodeling through the winter. One owner, one crew, free written estimates. Call or text (412) 758-4218.

## Services
- [Roofing](https://www.rgremodelpgh.com/roofing): Roof replacement, repair, and storm or insurance damage. Owens Corning systems, most roofs torn off and finished in a single day.
- [Remodeling](https://www.rgremodelpgh.com/remodeling): Kitchen and bathroom remodeling, built through the winter by the same crew that does the roofing.
- [Siding, Gutters and Decks](https://www.rgremodelpgh.com/exteriors): Siding replacement and repair, gutters, and decks.

## Company
- [About](https://www.rgremodelpgh.com/about): Owner-run since 1999, based in Castle Shannon, PA.
- [Service Area](https://www.rgremodelpgh.com/service-area): Pittsburgh's South Hills, including Castle Shannon, Bethel Park, Mt. Lebanon, Upper St. Clair, Baldwin, Whitehall, and Dormont, plus nearby Pittsburgh neighborhoods.
- [Contact](https://www.rgremodelpgh.com/contact): Free written estimate by phone or form.
